instruction:
One-Storey Creative Studio

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create an Archicad one-storey creative studio model and save the required output to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcBuildingStorey and exactly 5 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 1 IfcSlab entity and at least 2 IfcRoof entities.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: STUDIO, OFFICE, STORE, PANTRY, and WC.
7. Each listed space is assigned to the single IfcBuildingStorey.
8. The IFC area quantities for the spaces are STUDIO 96.0 m2, OFFICE 16.0 m2, STORE 12.0 m2, PANTRY 12.0 m2, and WC 8.0 m2, each with tolerance +/-0.10 m2.
9. The STUDIO area is between 95.0 m2 and 97.0 m2, and the total area of all listed spaces is between 143.0 m2 and 145.0 m2.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.

command: if exist "C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Archicad 29\Archicad Starter.exe" (echo OK) else (echo MISSING & exit /b 1)
